integrity: Closed forms proved with strict trace-inverse convexity, Laplacian spectral decomposition, scalar monotonicity; exact-rational checks are independently reproducible with verify_split.py, and do not stand in for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to symmetric nonnegative stochastic walks supported on complete split graphs with integer p,q >=2; no edge prices, mandated positive edge weights, asymmetric matrices, nonuniform stationary distribution, or SLEM objective. Literature-index coverage is incomplete; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact Kemeny-optimal symmetric walks on complete split graphs
